qa.q: What do you do to relax?
qa.a: Uhm, well first I should say I don't have much time to relax nowadays with a new baby. But when I do, uh, I love cycling. And any opportunity I get, I get out on the bike. Uhm, and it just helps me to switch off and uh, get some good uh, fitness and conditioning into the bargain.

qa.q: Do you think doing sports is a good way to relax?
qa.a: I think it depends on the sport. When I was younger I used to do a lot of uhm, uh, combat sports and possibly not the best way to relax. But nowadays a bit older, uh, I like more gentle forms of exercise such as cycling, which yeah, absolutely help me to relax.

qa.q: Do you think a vacation is a good time for you to relax?
qa.a: Personally speaking, uh, I'm not the most relaxed person when I go on holiday. I'm constantly thinking about all the airport, uhm, stuff that you have to do, checking in, making sure you have all your tickets, you haven't forgotten anything. And then it takes me three or four days to rewind. And then I realize I've got about four days left. So I'm not the most relaxed person when it comes to holidays. Some of my friends are, they find it easy to just switch off and lie on the beach. I'm not really one of those people.

qa.q: Do you think students need more time to relax?
qa.a: Yes, I mean, you know, uh, studying is a is a heavy investment, you know, um, financially, um, emotionally, and yeah, it can get quite stressful. So I think yeah, they do need time to switch off and recharge.

qa.q: If you had to choose a new activity to relax, what would it be? But it should be something that you've never done before and you think that it might relax you.
qa.a: Brendan: I can imagine, um, sailing being quite relaxing. Mm. Yeah. I've always, uh, wanted to try it. Rory: Well, I've had it on my to-do list for years now to learn how to meditate. I never quite get around to it. Maria: Um. Eating. Eating exotic food that I've never eaten before relaxes me. And going to some fancy restaurant.
